units.source_text: 红梅大纳言也派遣侍女们用的车辆来供使用。

en.t: The Grand Counselor Kobai also sent carriages used by his ladies in waiting for them to use.

units.source_text: 他的夫人是已故髭黑太政大臣前妻所生女儿真木柱，其对玉鬘尚侍的关系，从各方面来说都是很亲密的。

en.t: His wife was Makibashira, the daughter born to the late Chancellor Higekuro by his former wife, and in every respect her relationship with Tamakazura, the Naishi no Kami, was a very close one.

units.source_text: 然而真木柱竟毫无表示。

en.t: Yet Makibashira gave no sign of her intentions at all.

units.source_text: 只有她的同胞弟藤中纳言亲到，同两个异母弟即玉鬘所生的左近中将及右中弁一起帮办事务。

en.t: Only her full younger brother, the Middle Counselor Fuji, came in person and helped with the arrangements together with his two younger half brothers born to Tamakazura, the Sakon Middle Captain and the Uchuben.

units.source_text: 他们回想父亲在世之日，都不胜感慨。

en.t: As they remembered the days when their father was still alive, they were all overcome with emotion.
